description: Rotate PDF pages the right way up — sideways or upside-down. Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/pdf-rotate (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

angle.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees, added to whatever rotation each page already has. Lossless: nothing is re-rendered. A quarter turn when omitted.

data.description: The PDF to rotate, base64-encoded. A data: URL prefix is stripped. Send the whole file as it is, up to 20 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/pdf-rotate (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

name.description: Base name for the output file; a .pdf ending is dropped and the response names it <name>-rotated.pdf.

only.description: Filter the selected pages by their current orientation: landscape turns only pages wider than tall, portrait only pages taller than wide, all turns every selected page. The response lists which pages actually turned.

pages.description: Which pages to rotate, counted from 1: single pages and ranges separated by commas, such as "1-3, 7, 12-", where an open end runs to the last page. Omit for every page.

name: pdf_rotate
title: Rotate PDF
